title: Kissed with Spices Middle-Eastern Lamb Shawarma
description: A flavorful Middle-Eastern shawarma dish featuring lamb, rice stick noodles, and a soffritto-base, all kissed with aromatic spices.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the soffritto base, mixed spices, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add 200ml of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lamb is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice stick noodles according to the package instructions.
Slice the cooked lamb into thin strips.
Assemble the shawarma by placing a few slices of lamb onto a plate, followed by a portion of noodles, and topping with remaining soffritto base and spices.
